daily_report.title: HVAC / Liquid-Cooling CDU Industry Intelligence Briefing
daily_report.headline: DRAM shortage extended to 2028, MLCC leaders expanding capacity to hedge tight balance, copper choppy at highs; Chillventa 2026 closes with record 1,095 exhibitors.

hotspot_events.heat_reason: DRAM shortage cycle explicitly extended to 2028, HBM long-term agreements locking prices, clear Q4 contract-price uptrend window
hotspot_events.title: DRAM shortage cycle extended to 2028: DDR4 up 24% cumulatively over three months
hotspot_events.summary: Barclays (10-13): DDR4 contract prices +24% cumulatively over three months (DDR5 +20% over three months); DRAM supply-demand gap expected to peak in 2027Q4 (gap rate 13.9%), NAND in 2028Q1 (8.3%); JPMorgan (10-14) estimates the 2027 HBM market +149% YoY to $160 billion, with Micron locking 2027 HBM prices significantly above last year and over 75% of FY2027 output under long-term agreements.
numbers: DDR4 contract prices +24% over three months
DDR5 contract prices +20% over three months
Micron: over 75% of FY2027 output under long-term agreements

hotspot_events.heat_reason: Murata book-to-bill ratio 1.47 record high with more capex planned; tight balance carries into the next price-adjustment window
hotspot_events.title: MLCC tight balance continues: Murata plans more capacity, book-to-bill ratio 1.47 record high
hotspot_events.summary: Murata plans additional MLCC capacity investment (amount to be disclosed at 10-30 earnings), saying the current expansion (JPY 80 billion over two years, output +10~15%) is still insufficient, with book-to-bill ratio at a record 1.47; Yageo September revenue NT$17.068 billion (+46% YoY, 7th consecutive monthly record), Walsin NT$4.889 billion (near 8-year high).

hotspot_events.title: Copper choppy at highs: LME closed 10-13 at $14,621.5/ton
hotspot_events.summary: LME copper closed 10-13 at $14,621.5/ton (+0.49%), easing overnight 10-14 to $14,555.5/ton; choppy at highs; SHFE 2611 contract closed 10-13 at RMB 110,890/ton; inventories remain low.

hotspot_events.heat_reason: E-glass cloth hikes officially confirmed with no scaled new capacity until end of next year; price-hike chain continues
hotspot_events.title: E-glass cloth hikes officially confirmed: no new capacity until end of next year
hotspot_events.summary: E-glass cloth October hikes officially confirmed by leading listed companies (China Securities Journal 10-12); no scaled new capacity before year-end, concentrated releases not until end of next year; Taiwan PCB/CCL makers posted fast Q3 revenue growth (Tripod +142% YoY, Taiflex +122%, Gold Circuit +69%).

industry_updates.title: Chillventa 2026 closes with record 1,095 exhibitors
industry_updates.summary: Held 10-13~15 in Nuremberg, Germany — the largest edition on record; natural refrigerants (R290/CO2/ammonia) and data-center cooling were the core themes.

industry_updates.title: Johnson Controls debuts YORK YMAE-P R290 high-temperature heat pump at Chillventa
industry_updates.summary: Propane reversible air-source high-temperature heat pump, 90–360 kW cooling capacity, up to 80°C water outlet, operating at -25°C ambient — R290 technology landing in finished units.

industry_updates.title: Carrier launches WeatherFlex 50FC R-454C rooftop units
industry_updates.summary: 20–50 kW, using A2L refrigerant R-454C with GWP <150, preparing for the EU F-gas tightening from 2027.

industry_updates.title: Daikin Applied Phoenix plant expansion online, capacity up ~150%
industry_updates.summary: Modular Solutions plant grew from 58,000 to 191,000 sq ft, enabling in-factory integrated production of Chilldyne direct-to-chip CDU and DDC S-series rack containment — data-center cooling capacity investment.

industry_updates.title: Panasonic showcases R290/CO2 compressors and high-efficiency fan motors at Chillventa
industry_updates.summary: R290/CO2 rotary compressors, scroll compressors, PY-125 water pumps, and the whisperTECH fan motor series co-developed with SIT.

industry_updates.title: Vertiv delivers India's first high-density direct-to-chip liquid-cooled data center
industry_updates.summary: In partnership with CapitaLand India Trust, the Mumbai CLDC 01 project uses a secondary fluid network (SFN) supporting 30 MW of AI load.
